checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both hands remain closed around the fixed overhead bar.
checks.feet: Both legs remain horizontal with straight knees throughout the pull-up. Fixed grip, controlled vertical trunk motion, chin above bar at top.
checks.movement: Overhand L-sit pull-up, straight horizontal legs maintained throughout. Start with extended arms, pull chin above bar, return under control; 3.5 seconds up, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds down. Entry into L-sit omitted.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
